messages:
lex: Short follow-up from postmortem: we keep seeing the cache-eviction loop. Need three bite-sized runbook edits: 5-step fast triage, pasteable ops commands, and a tiny escalation ladder with timeboxes. Who can take each?

tara: I can write the 5-step triage. Draft will be one-line actions: 1) scope (model vs cluster), 2) snapshot kvcache KPIs, 3) check eviction reason codes, 4) apply immediate mitigation, 5) tag & notify.

mike: I'll do ops commands. Will add exact snippets to copy/paste: ```sh
# list evictions (30m)
redwoodctl telemetry events list --type eviction --since 30m
# kvcache hit-rate (5m)
redwoodctl metrics query "increase(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_requests_total[5m])"
# tail runtime logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime -c runtime --since=15m | tail -n 200
# fallback route
redwoodctl route set --model model-small --traffic 100% --reason \"eviction-fallback\"
```

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1999 linked and reminder set: runbook edits due in 5d.

ops-helper: Escalation ladder proposal: oncall ack <10m, eng-sre engaged <20m if not mitigated, eng-runtime notified <45m, leads + customer-sre at 90m. I'll own the contact table and confirm prim/sec.

lex: Add telemetry markers to triage: 95th token latency, kvcache hit-rate drop >25%, eviction-rate spike. Playbook rule: when unsure, reduce traffic to suspect model before mass restarts.

tara: ACK. I'll publish the 5-step doc and include the telemetry markers (due 2bd).

mike: ACK. I'll open a small PR with commands + example outputs (due 3bd).

ops-helper: ACK. I'll produce contact table + SLA timeboxes (due 4bd) and schedule a quick review.

lex: Thanks all ":white_check_mark:" We'll track in the postmortem action tracker and close when merged.
